name: io.github.ocnai/kebivo
title: Kebivo
description: Self-hosted inbox for questions your AI agents couldn't answer. Report knowledge gaps over MCP.

runtimeArguments.name: --publish
runtimeArguments.description: Expose Kebivo on host loopback port 8000 only

runtimeArguments.name: --volume
runtimeArguments.description: Named volume for the SQLite database

environmentVariables.name: SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: At least 32 random characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32

environmentVariables.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 64 hex characters from openssl rand -hex 32; back it up apart from the data volume

environmentVariables.name: ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Browser origin allowed to sign in to the admin UI

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Kebivo project token, issued in the admin UI

kebivo_token.description: Project token from the Kebivo admin UI (select a project, then Project tokens)
